tools.name: triple_trigger_scan
tools.description: Run one SML Triple-Trigger SPEC v2 scan of a ticker on live Schwab data and get a VERDICT (all three triggers true, with entry/stop/target/R plan), WATCH (two of three), or NONE result, with market/volatility/cap tags and data timestamps. Use it to check whether a ticker currently shows a liquidity

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: triple_trigger_scan · Public sink: triple_trigger_scan · Destructive: triple_trigger_scan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: triple_trigger_scan · Public sink: triple_trigger_scan · Destructive: triple_trigger_scan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
